text:
alex: Customer on hosted API submitted a refund request but our autorouter invoked reschedule_shipment instead. user says they never received item and asked for refund; support UI shows "Refund requested: amount missing in payload". Ticket #C-98172. :eyes:

maya: can you paste the raw request/body + headers? curious if locale/currency fields are empty or malformed.

alex: sending reproduction from the support UI logs. note: amount omitted in body (agent typed 'refund' but left amount blank). headers include Accept-Language: en-GB.

alex: ```
POST /v1/support/actions HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
Content-Type: application/json
Accept-Language: en-GB

{
  "customer_id": "cus_12345",
  "intent": null,
  "reason": "never received item",
  "amount": null,
  "currency": "GBP",
  "metadata": {"ticket": "C-98172"}
}
```

liam: hmm. reschedule_shipment and issue_refund both have similar signatures in the tool catalog: both accept optional "amount" and "note" fields. when amount is null, our fuzzy dispatcher falls back to action names and picks the closest-phrased Tool (reschedule contains "shipment" and UI had "delivery" in free text) -> misroute. :face_with_monocle:

sam: can we short-term: 1) prefer tools that include the word "refund" when free-text contains refund/refunded/refund request; 2) treat explicit null/absent amount as bias-towards-refund when "refund_reason" or "never received" present.

support-bot: ERROR log (autodispatch): dispatcher=autoroute-v3 decision=reschedule_shipment confidence=0.42 features={has_amount:false, contains_delivery:true, contains_refund_word:false(0.0)}

maya: agree with sam. also we should add a schema discriminator flag on support UI when agents hit the "refund" quick action so requests set intent: "refund". quick UX fix.

liam: i'll push a hotfix to routing weights (increase refund score when refund-related tokens present, and penalize reschedule when amount is missing). will canary tomorrow morning.

sam: paste the patch diff here when ready and i'll review. also include a unit test that reproduces the case where payload.amount == null -> autoroute should pick issue_refund.

alex: customer is blocked until we route correctly. assigning to oncall to expedite. ticket updated and customer notified that we're investigating. :thumbsup:

maya: plan: (A) UI quick fix to set intent, (B) routing weight tweak canary, (C) longer-term: require explicit required fields in tool schemas (avoid optional amount for refund-like tools). assigning PRs.

liam: noted. I'll include logs and repro script. thanks all.
